text:
alex: Heads up — partner ETL job flooded the ingest endpoint this morning and we had to manually top up their key. Thinking we should formalize a short "grace/top-up" workflow for internal/partner keys so ops doesn't have to intervene constantly :wave:

jamie: ugh. saw the spike in the dashboard. Do we know if it was retry storms or legitimate traffic? :eyes:

priya: Alerts showed retries + a few long tail backfills. Their client wasn't honoring 429 backoff. We have per-org quota but because they use a partner key shared across projects it hit the global key threshold quickly.

marta: For product ops, having an escape hatch that doesn't bypass billing would be ideal. We can do temporary burst credits that are charged and then reconciled.

alex: Proposal sketch: 1) allow short automatic grace window (e.g., 5m) with fixed burst tokens attached to key; 2) console action to grant manual top-up (+X tokens, expires in Y); 3) audit log + email and slack notify to key owner; 4) rate-limit enforcement still kicks in if top-up exhausted.

jamie: Implementation note: enforcement should live in the edge proxy layer so we don't add extra RTT to the runtime. Edge can check key metadata (remaining tokens, expiry) and permit/deny. We already push key-metadata to edge cache via kvsync.

priya: Agree on edge enforcement. Also add a circuit-breaker flag per-key so if a key repeatedly needs top-ups we auto-disable top-up and escalate.

alex: Example console JSON for a manual override button (for ops):

```json
{
  "key_id": "sk-partner-123",
  "grant_tokens": 50000,
  "expires_at": "2026-05-07T14:10:00Z",
  "reason": "one-off data backfill",
  "initiated_by": "ops"
}
```

jamie: Edge needs a compact representation. Maybe store burst credits as {credits:int, window_s:int, origin:str} in the key-heads cache. Keep update path idempotent.

marta: UX question: should manual top-ups require two approvals for enterprise customers? Legal/security may require audit + approver.

priya: Yes — for enterprise keys we should gate manual top-ups with 2FA + approver or at least record approver. The code path: ops console -> call /admin/keys/topup -> policy check -> write to key-store -> kvsync picks up -> edge enforces.

alex: We also need telemetry hooks: per-key time series for consumed tokens, top-up events, grace-window triggers. Add alert if top-ups exceed threshold in a week.

jamie: Telemetry detail: emit events to metrics pipeline: `key.topup`, `key.burst_used`, `key.grace_start`, `key.grace_end`. Tag with org_id, key_id, route, and request_shard to trace back to proxied instance.

priya: We should avoid applying top-ups that increase sustained capacity — enforce a cap on re-issues e.g., no more than 3 top-ups in 24h without approver. Circuit-breaker will block beyond that.

marta: For billing: add a reconciliation job that consumes top-up credits into usage ledger within 24h and shows line items on invoice. Ops top-ups are visible in console and billing export.

alex: Anything else? Also need a safe default for internal service keys (low-risk) vs partner keys. Internal service keys might get automated short grace by default.

jamie: Need to think about roaming tokens: partner may present multiple key variants (dev/dup). We should tie overrides to a canonical key id (and prevent duplicates from being top-upped automatically).

priya: Security: log the IP and user agent when top-up is applied and alert if top-ups from unfamiliar locations.

marta: Ops flow: quick button -> `+manual top-up` -> dropdown for expiry (1h/6h/24h/custom) -> comment field. Defaults: 1h and 50k tokens.

alex: I'll draft an RFC with route-level details (edge checks, kvsync schema, console CTA, billing mapping). Want to avoid making quota model more complex to customers — internal override behavior should be fully visible in console.

sre-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-042 top-up manual for sk-partner-123 by alex at 2026-05-07T14:02:13Z

jamie: Sounds good. I'll prototype the kv payload and edge check today. Priya can add the circuit-breaker heuristics. Marta will confirm product/billing UX.

priya: Ping me on the draft RFC when ready. Also include tests for race scenarios where kvsync lags and two simultaneous top-ups occur.

alex: Cool — I'll post a short RFC link in this thread once done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
